import random, sys, collections, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from te.session import run_case
import gen as G, verify as V
import te.engine.worker as W
sizes=collections.Counter()
orig=W.solve_worker
def wrap(owned,paths,caps,demand,mode,rho,B):
    ctx=W._Context(owned,paths,caps,demand,mode,rho,B)
    sizes[len(ctx.var)]+=1
    return orig(owned,paths,caps,demand,mode,rho,B)
W.solve_worker=wrap
import te.session as S
S.solve_worker=wrap
rng=random.Random(0)
t0=time.time()
bad=0
for i in range(30):
    req=G.gen_request(rng,big=True)
    resp={"cases":[run_case(c) for c in req['cases']]}
    errs=V.verify(req,resp)
    if errs: bad+=1; print("ERR", errs[0]['errors'][:5])
print("bad",bad,"time %.1f"%(time.time()-t0))
print("var counts:", sorted(sizes.items())[-12:])
print("total issues", sum(sizes.values()))
